title: Scenario coverage evaluation
responsibility: Judges declared scenario coverage against a selected record and recorded change impact.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.detail
inputs.description: Revision holding the impact data used to decide whether the unit changed relative to the record. A matching record comparison wins; first-parent source impact applies only when its base equals the record base, and missing unit lists yield null.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.record
inputs.description: Record whose ID selects a matching comparison and whose source base selects first-parent source impact. The comparison takes precedence, and source impact is ignored when its base differs from the record base.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier searched in the selected impact’s direct, indirect, and added lists. A unit found only in removed is not counted, and no applicable unit lists yields null.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.detail
inputs.description: Revision supplying unit-to-state filtering and the impact history used for inherited-result lineage. An inherited result remains stale when no applicable impact provides unit lists, and a matching record comparison takes precedence over source impact.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.record
inputs.description: Record providing the scenario result, source commit, recorded tests, state outcomes, and captures; inherited results may also use origin tests with browserErrors. Null supplies no recorded test outcomes and applies the absent standing to each state.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier used to select the scenario states that apply to this unit and to check whether an inherited result is stale. States are filtered using the revision’s unit registry, and missing impact history cannot prove an inherited result unaffected.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.absent
default: No verification record is attached to this commit.
inputs.description: Standing and reason used when no record is supplied; its standing is applied to every state, while its reason is retained for the scenario. Defaults to the literal tuple shown in the default.
examples: No verification record is attached to this commit.

outputs.name: coverageAffected
outputs.description: True when the applicable impact lists the unit, false when applicable unit lists omit it, or null when no applicable unit list exists. A record-specific comparison is preferred; source impact applies only when its base matches the record base.

outputs.name: explorerCoverage
outputs.description: The returned callback accepts a declared scenario and returns its ExplorerScenarioCoverage for this unit, including applicable state and test findings. Its standing is the worst scenario and state finding, so missing, unrecorded, or unknown evidence cannot establish a pass.
